exposure: updated ROP screening criteria (specifically the reduced gestational age threshold)
cohort: Six premature babies who underwent screening and treatment for ROP prior to the implementation of new guidelines, but whose characteristics (likely gestational age) would now fall outside the updated ROP screening criteria.
finding: Six babies were identified who received ROP screening and treatment that would have been forfeited under the March 2022 guidelines, despite all having numerous systemic risk factors for ROP and documented poor postnatal weight gain.
gest_age: The updated ROP screening criteria reduced the gestational age threshold for screening from 32 to 31 weeks; the study examined babies who would fall outside these new criteria.
